unit_entry.name: feature-dispatch-tree
unit_entry.scope: Complete14D2E dispatch across three genuine C architectural units and829E getter; relative tables bind true symbols. C owns free-bank memory/constant/bit operations, reserved-S0/frame/control/PC effects are explicit ports. All downstream70 direct providers, ROM ABI, memory ownership, IRQ/startup/physical hardware and OTA remain unproved. Static checks only; no target execution.
